## Does this change emitted bytes?

## Format spec

If anything new lands in a file, quote the clause of docs/portolano-format.md

## Version

- [ ] patch (CLI behaviour only — emitted files byte-identical)
- [ ] minor (new option, new source, new format, or emitted bytes moved)
- [ ] major (needs a new `format` value — describe the break above)

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes, with the network unavailable
- [ ] New tests run against a fixture in `test/fixtures/`, never a live fetch
- [ ] Tests assert values — counts, bytes, coordinates, digests — not printed layout
- [ ] Output is still deterministic: same inputs, same bytes, any platform
- [ ] Still zero runtime dependencies
- [ ] Branched from latest `main` (rebased, not merged)
- [ ] One logical change
